destination.question: How do AdS systems change phase, respond to perturbations and evolve over long times, and how are these behaviors interpreted through boundary observables and unitarity?

evidence.text: Can a gravitational description of eternal BTZ reproduce finite-volume unitary relaxation and Poincaré recurrences, rather than indefinite quasinormal decay? Does summing semiclassical topologies suffice, or is a nonperturbative modification of the horizon needed?

sources.title: Monopoles and Holography

evidence.text: The holographic dictionary distinguishes homogeneous leading source terms from spatially modulated subleading expectation values. A prescribed square modulation of an Abelian scalar at the wall is propagated toward the boundary using a modified-Bessel-function solution as a toy estimate.

sources.title: Confinement in Anti-de Sitter Space

evidence.text: SO(3,2) representation shortening protects the single-gluon energy near weak coupling. A bulk partition function with boundary gauge-field sources generates formal current correlators and supports a state/operator interpretation.

sources.title: Resonant Hamiltonian systems and weakly nonlinear dynamics in AdS spacetimes

evidence.text: Transform field and momentum into slowly varying complex mode amplitudes, project onto linear modes, and time-average away explicit oscillatory terms. This produces the same effective dynamics as secular-term resummation.

sources.title: Can black hole relax unitarily?

evidence.text: For proposed horizon modifications, use reflected null geodesics and optical volume to estimate return times, and impose normalizability with Dirichlet conditions at the wormhole’s two spatial infinities to characterize real normal frequencies.

sources.title: Restoring unitarity in BTZ black hole

evidence.text: The massless scalar radial equation is transformed into a Schrödinger problem. A near-throat potential proportional to λ²sinh²z is analyzed with WKB quantization and elliptic-integral asymptotics; the available exact Toda-lattice technique is not used.

sources.title: Monopoles and Holography

evidence.text: An Abelian magnetic-bag approximation neglects lattice detail and non-Abelian fields. The interior has φ=B=0; exterior scalar and magnetic fields determine an energy whose minimization fixes the wall position. Scalar profiles for nonzero λ are obtained numerically.

sources.title: Delayed collapses of Bose-Einstein condensates in relation to anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Direct evolution uses fourth-order finite differences and fourth-order Runge–Kutta, enforcing ∂rψ=0 at the origin. The authors report testing an outer boundary rmax=50, where the field is about 10⁻¹⁵, against evolution in a compactified radial coordinate.

sources.title: Dynamics of collapsing and exploding Bose–Einstein condensates

evidence.text: Burst energies are extracted from harmonic refocusing: a radial focus reveals the axial energy distribution, and an axial focus reveals radial energy. Gaussian fits characterize the distributions with direction-dependent effective temperatures.

sources.title: Delayed collapses of Bose-Einstein condensates in relation to anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: A harmonic-oscillator mode expansion and slow-amplitude averaging yield a resonant interaction system with channel i+j=k+l. Coupling coefficients are evaluated through mode-overlap integrals; their large-index behavior is investigated using Laguerre-to-Bessel asymptotics and numerical integration.

sources.title: Delayed collapses of Bose-Einstein condensates in relation to anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Numerical quality monitoring uses conserved norm and Hamiltonian, the virial identity, and convergence comparisons between resolutions. Global spatial refinement targets relative conservation deviations below 10⁻⁶; the authors report reliable evolution until very near collapse.

sources.title: Dynamics of collapsing and exploding Bose–Einstein condensates

evidence.text: Magnetic-field sequences jump from ainit to acollapse in 0.1 ms, evolve for τevolve, then quench the collapse. A rapid positive-a expansion followed by destructive absorption imaging measures atom number and indirectly probes the pre-expansion bulk size.

sources.title: Dynamics of collapsing and exploding Bose–Einstein condensates

evidence.text: Jet kinetic energy is used to infer prequench confinement and spike width. The reported v ≃1 mm/s corresponds to approximately 6 nK and radial Gaussian rms width ∼0.5 μm. Density estimates assume disk-shaped jets and an unresolved axial width equal to the harmonic-oscillator length.

destination.title: Holographic descriptions, bulk observables and curved-space dynamics
destination.question: How can boundary observables describe gravitational systems, reconstruct bulk physics and test its consistency, and how do related curved-space dynamics and scattering methods delimit these descriptions?
destination.summary: A proposed organizing family spanning AdS/CFT, conjectured cosmological holography, bulk reconstruction and tests of gravitational descriptions. Different dimensions, quantizations, states and notions of locality remain separate. Analogue collapse and standalone field constructions supply comparison routes.

sources.title: Partition Functions of Three-Dimensional Pure Gravity

evidence.text: Can genus-two partition functions of extremal CFTs at general c = 24k be constructed consistently and uniquely, and can gravitational instanton sums reproduce them, conditional on those CFTs existing?

sources.title: The inside outs of AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$: exact AdS wormholes with entangled CFT duals

evidence.text: Can independent stress-tensor data at two asymptotically AdS3 boundaries be completed into exact geometries with smooth horizons and wormhole interiors, and identified with explicit entangled CFT2 states through observable matching?

sources.title: Wormholes, Emergent Gauge Fields, and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How can wormhole-threading bulk Wilson lines be represented in the tensor product of two boundary CFTs, and can resolving this factorization problem motivate charge completeness and a stronger weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Gravitational S-matrix from CFT dispersion relations

evidence.text: Can singularities of the stress-tensor-multiplet four-point correlator reconstruct strong-coupling N=4 SYM data through order 1/N⁴, reproduce the dual one-loop flat-space gravitational S-matrix, and characterize the contact-term ambiguities?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Emergence of Bulk Physics in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How does local bulk effective field theory emerge from a CFT, which CFTs support it, and where does it fail? These review lectures emphasize Lorentzian physics at fixed time and the route from quantum error correction to entanglement-wedge reconstruction.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can FRW boundary correlators define a quantum theory encompassing multiple dS parents and landscape transitions? The source identifies unknown perturbation boundary conditions, a missing Hilbert-space interpretation, and an unestablished averaging prescription.

sources.title: Codimension two holography for wedges

evidence.text: Can gravity on a (d+1)-dimensional AdS wedge admit a codimension-two CFT dual on its (d−1)-dimensional corner, and do free energy, anomaly, entanglement and scalar-spectrum calculations support that proposal? A second question concerns Lorentzian wedges dual to spacelike CFT boundaries.

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: How are bulk scalar couplings translated into boundary correlators with the numerical normalization needed for coupling bounds?

sources.title: Rindler bulk reconstruction and subregion duality in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can CFT operators supported in a boundary subregion reconstruct all local bulk fields in its AdS-Rindler wedge, once the distinction between a UV-complete free field and finite-N quantum gravity is retained?

sources.title: Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity with matter, generalized eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, and random matrices

evidence.text: Can JT gravity minimally coupled to a free massive scalar be described by an effective two-matrix ensemble that generalizes ETH, matches gravitational disk correlators, and determines cylinder amplitudes and their UV pathologies?

sources.title: Do holographic CFT states have unique semiclassical bulk duals?

evidence.text: Can one fixed holographic CFT state have two simple semiclassical bulk descriptions differing by the presence of a closed universe? Which bulk-boundary dictionary and inner product then describe an observer's experience?

sources.title: Eternal black holes in anti-de Sitter

evidence.text: How can the maximally extended Schwarzschild-AdS spacetime, including its interior, be described nonperturbatively, and how can its exponentially decaying semiclassical correlators be reconciled with boundary unitarity?

sources.title: Cosmological models and renormalization group flow

evidence.text: How do positive-Λ perfect-fluid cosmologies differ in causal structure, and what do their horizons imply for a proposed dS/CFT renormalization group interpretation and covariant entropy bounds?

sources.title: A Comment on multiple vacua, particle production and the time dependent AdS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT encode multiple natural vacua in time-dependent backgrounds, and how does cosmological particle production relate bulk and boundary in-in versus in-out correlators?

sources.title: Time-dependent spacetimes in AdS/CFT: Bubble and black hole

evidence.text: How do horizons, thermodynamics and de Sitter vacuum ambiguities in the AdS bubble of nothing and locally AdS black hole map to their boundary CFT?

sources.title: Product CFTs, gravitational cloning, massive gravitons and the space of gravitational duals

evidence.text: Can AdS/CFT realize interacting theories with multiple gravitons, which gravitons remain massless, and what bulk structures describe large-N CFTs coupled through products of operators?

sources.title: Anti de Sitter space and holography

evidence.text: How can boundary conformal-field-theory observables be computed from bulk supergravity or string theory, including operator dimensions, protected spectra and large-N thermodynamics?

sources.title: AdS dynamics from conformal field theory

evidence.text: To what extent can local bulk string and supergravity dynamics be recovered from CFT operators, particularly beyond the free large-N limit, and what can this description say about black-hole infall, complementarity, and the BTZ singularity?

sources.title: Negative energy, superluminosity and holography

evidence.text: How can boundary SYM encode distant bulk collisions before their signals reach the boundary, while its stress tensor subsequently exhibits apparently instantaneous redistribution, superluminal oscillations and negative local energy?

sources.title: Partition Functions of Three-Dimensional Pure Gravity

evidence.text: Relate the regularized Einstein-Hilbert action to a classical Liouville action, then use holomorphic factorization of the scalar Laplacian determinant to select a holomorphically factorized action in the chosen boundary normalization.

sources.title: The inside outs of AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$: exact AdS wormholes with entangled CFT duals

evidence.text: Apply exact Brown–Henneaux-type solution-generating diffeomorphisms, parameterized by G± on the right and H± on the left, in four Eddington–Finkelstein charts. Leave a fifth Kruskal chart unchanged and identify overlapping descriptions through trivial diffeomorphisms.

sources.title: Wormholes, Emergent Gauge Fields, and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Hamiltonian Gauss constraints and spatial operator algebras diagnose nonfactorization. In ordinary lattice scalar electrodynamics, left and right gauge-invariant algebras still omit a Wilson-line degree of freedom; shared central electric-flux operators obstruct tensor factors.

sources.title: Gravitational S-matrix from CFT dispersion relations

evidence.text: Expand data in inverse powers of conformal spin using twist conformal blocks and contour projectors. Casimir operators simplify integrals by integration by parts; resumming the spin expansion and changing variables yields the Froissart-Gribov kernel.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Emergence of Bulk Physics in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Erasure correction is analyzed through logical-operator reconstruction, reference-system decoupling and encoding unitaries. Entropy inequalities yield m ≥ (n+k)/2 for n physical qudits, k logical qudits and threshold m, under the stated symmetry of recoverability.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Estimate horizon-mediated R violation using a massive-particle round trip and a random walk over horizon degrees of freedom, then seek a self-consistent vanishing mass at infinite dS radius. The source explicitly presents this as a heuristic mechanism.

sources.title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime

evidence.text: For discrete-series bulk fields with integer boundary dimensions, how does Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) in extended-Poincaré de Sitter scattering relate to boundary conformal anomalies and holographic renormalisability, and which contact interactions satisfy each condition?

sources.title: Bulk reconstruction in rotating BTZ black hole

evidence.text: How can a scalar field in rotating BTZ be represented by boundary CFT operators outside and inside the outer horizon, especially near the inner Cauchy horizon? What changes when interior reconstruction uses state-dependent mirror operators on a single boundary?

sources.title: Can black hole relax unitarily?

evidence.text: How can BTZ relaxation governed by complex quasi-normal frequencies be reconciled with quasi-periodic unitary evolution in a finite-volume boundary CFT, and what finite-k modifications of the semiclassical geometry might realize this behavior?

evidence.text: How does the complex AdS representation of the Hartle–Hawking no-boundary wave function affect primordial scalar and tensor spectra, compared with a dS/CFT prescription using real AdS domain walls and exact Bunch–Davies initial conditions?

sources.title: Constructing local bulk observables in interacting AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can CFT operators represent interacting bulk observables beyond leading large N while satisfying bulk locality, defined as commutation at spacelike separation?

sources.title: Remark about dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can Witten's modified de Sitter inner product, together with a conjectured identification of bulk initial states and boundary CFT states, determine boundary correlators without an explicit realization of dS/CFT?

sources.title: AdS Field Theory from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Which bottom-up properties of CFT correlators guarantee a perturbative AdS effective field theory with a cutoff parametrically above the curvature scale, and what constraints follow for conserved higher-spin interactions?

sources.title: No ensemble averaging below the black hole threshold

evidence.text: Can fixed-energy observables in AdS/CFT avoid apparent ensemble averaging despite connected bulk contributions with disconnected boundaries, and can hyperbolic three-manifold geometry establish this in the semiclassical AdS3 setting?

evidence.text: Can parametrically scale-separated AdS admit a holographic CFT obtained by decoupling a string-theory brane, and what asymptotic scalar-potential condition does this require?

evidence.text: How can smeared CFT operators represent an AdS scalar interacting with gravity while satisfying the appropriate spacelike commutation relations and transforming correctly under AdS isometries?

sources.title: Emergent Times in Holographic Duality

evidence.text: Can boundary operators generate emergent infalling evolutions that carry bulk Cauchy slices behind an eternal AdS black-hole horizon, while exposing its interior and causal structure?

sources.title: Bulk versus boundary dynamics in anti-de Sitter space-time

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT accommodate tunable boundary sources and the normalizable modes required for Hamiltonian quantization, and how much local bulk dynamics can its boundary generating functional describe?

sources.title: Self-binding energies in AdS

evidence.text: How do neutral scalar exchange, including massive scalars and derivative couplings, and quartic contact interactions affect charged-particle self-binding in AdS4 and AdS5, and hence the effective-theory constraints proposed by positive binding?

sources.title: Gauge theory correlators from noncritical string theory

evidence.text: Can boundary-condition dependence of an AdS supergravity action generate large-N N=4 Yang–Mills correlators and predict strong-coupling dimensions of operators coupled to excited string states?

sources.title: A Stress tensor for Anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: How can one define a finite boundary stress tensor and conserved gravitational charges for asymptotically locally AdS spacetimes without requiring a reference-space embedding, while recovering stress-tensor properties expected from the proposed dual CFT?

sources.title: Nonlinear Laplace equation, de Sitter vacua, and information geometry

evidence.text: What do exact, nonperturbative solutions of critical interacting scalar theories reveal about AdS/CFT, the information geometry of solution moduli, and classical scalar descriptions on de Sitter backgrounds?

sources.title: The Gravity Dual of a Density Matrix

evidence.text: Given a boundary subregion density matrix ρ_A in a state with a classical geometric AdS/CFT dual, what is the largest bulk region fully reconstructible from it, equivalently common to all geometric duals compatible with that density matrix?

sources.title: On the holographic S matrix

evidence.text: Can the ordinary S-matrix of an interacting massless scalar theory in five-dimensional Minkowski spacetime be recovered from timelike-boundary data of a bulk AdS theory in the flat-space limit? The paper emphasizes that the answer depends on what bulk quantization is intended.

evidence.text: Can the same CFT state consistently encode a semiclassical disconnected baby universe and a bulk without one, while retaining the conventional extrapolate dictionary and causal-wedge encoding?

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit useful weakly coupled holographic descriptions, and why would factorization and CFT consistency naturally lead an observer to introduce AdS fields and Witten diagrams?

sources.title: Monopoles and Holography

evidence.text: What boundary ground states and phase transitions arise from dynamical solitonic magnetic monopoles in AdS4 when a homogeneous magnetic field is applied without a chemical potential?

sources.title: The Factorization Problem in Jackiw-Teitelboim Gravity

evidence.text: Can pure Lorentzian JT gravity define a consistent quantum system while failing the boundary factorization required by AdS/CFT? The paper constructs its physical degrees of freedom, interprets Hartle–Hawking states, and examines how a factorizing microscopic completion changes the picture.

sources.title: Focusing bounds for CFT correlators and the S-matrix

evidence.text: How are bulk ANEC, gravitational focusing, and causality encoded in the flat-space S-matrix and holographic CFT correlators, and what constraints stronger than causality follow?

sources.title: Harmonic functions and gravity localization

evidence.text: Can singular internal geometries support nonconstant normalizable massless-graviton wavefunctions, and how can geometric spectral bounds determine massive-graviton localization and constrain scale separation in AdS?

sources.title: The Holographic Weyl anomaly

evidence.text: For CFTs described by the conjectured AdS/CFT correspondence, how does the effective action depend on the chosen representative of the boundary conformal metric, and what Weyl anomaly follows from covariantly regularizing the bulk gravitational action?

sources.title: Holographic representation of bulk fields with spin in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can bulk spin-one and spin-two fields be represented as smeared CFT operators, and which notions of locality survive gauge redundancy, interactions in 1/N perturbation theory, and extensions beyond a fixed AdS background?

sources.title: Imprints of flat space analyticity in de Sitter S-matrix

evidence.text: How are flat-space amplitude singularities and exchanged-particle masses encoded in the de Sitter S-matrix, and can a suitable limit support a flat-space-like EFT interpretation? Positivity and Swampland constraints motivate the investigation.

sources.title: Restoring unitarity in BTZ black hole

evidence.text: Can a gravitational description of eternal BTZ reproduce finite-volume unitary relaxation and Poincaré recurrences, rather than indefinite quasinormal decay? Does summing semiclassical topologies suffice, or is a nonperturbative modification of the horizon needed?

sources.title: Construction of Bulk Fields with Gauge Redundancy

evidence.text: How can boundary-operator smearing reconstruct gauge and gravitational bulk fields, and what physical meaning and locality remain after gauge fixing and imposing Gauss-law constraints?

sources.title: Holographic representation of local bulk operators

evidence.text: How are free local bulk fields represented by nonlocal CFT operators in Lorentzian AdS/CFT, how sharply can their boundary support be localized, and what does this suggest about finite-N locality and holographic counting?

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can approximate bulk locality, especially radial locality and reconstruction on overlapping boundary regions, emerge when the full CFT operator algebra cannot obey the apparent bulk commutation relations?

sources.title: Bulk and Transhorizon Measurements in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can effective bulk observables, including measurements behind an AdS black-hole horizon, be represented in the dual CFT? In particular, can the CFT encode a measurement distinguishing a live from a dead cat behind the horizon?

sources.title: A Study of Quantum Field Theories in AdS at Finite Coupling

evidence.text: How can finite-coupling QFT observables on AdS connect boundary conformal correlators, flat-space scattering and BCFT data, while exposing nonperturbative spectral phenomena through large-N resummation?

sources.title: The Holographic bound in anti-de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does AdS/CFT implement the holographic information bound, beyond identifying a gravitational bulk theory with a boundary theory, when both boundary area and boundary entropy are initially infinite?

sources.title: On Non-handlebody Instantons in 3D Gravity

evidence.text: How can non-handlebody hyperbolic instantons contribute to the holomorphically factorized partition function of pure three-dimensional gravity with negative cosmological constant, and what does their degeneration imply for a proposed extremal-CFT dual?

destinations.title: Can genus-two partition functions of extremal CFTs at general c = 24k be constructed consistently and uniquely, and can gravitational instanton sums reproduce them, conditional on those CFTs existing?

Can independent stress-tensor data at two asymptotically AdS3 boundaries be completed into exact geometries with smooth horizons and wormhole interiors, and identified with explicit entangled CFT2 states through observable matching?

How can wormhole-threading bulk Wilson lines be represented in the tensor product of two boundary CFTs, and can resolving this factorization problem motivate charge completeness and a stronger weak gravity conjecture?

Can singularities of the stress-tensor-multiplet four-point correlator reconstruct strong-coupling N=4 SYM data through order 1/N⁴, reproduce the dual one-loop flat-space gravitational S-matrix, and characterize the contact-term ambiguities?

How does local bulk effective field theory emerge from a CFT, which CFTs support it, and where does it fail? These review lectures emphasize Lorentzian physics at fixed time and the route from quantum error correction to entanglement-wedge reconstruction.

Can FRW boundary correlators define a quantum theory encompassing multiple dS parents and landscape transitions? The source identifies unknown perturbation boundary conditions, a missing Hilbert-space interpretation, and an unestablished averaging prescription.

Can gravity on a (d+1)-dimensional AdS wedge admit a codimension-two CFT dual on its (d−1)-dimensional corner, and do free energy, anomaly, entanglement and scalar-spectrum calculations support that proposal? A second question concerns Lorentzian wedges dual to spacelike CFT boundaries.
How are bulk scalar couplings translated into boundary correlators with the numerical normalization needed for coupling bounds?

Can CFT operators supported in a boundary subregion reconstruct all local bulk fields in its AdS-Rindler wedge, once the distinction between a UV-complete free field and finite-N quantum gravity is retained?

Can JT gravity minimally coupled to a free massive scalar be described by an effective two-matrix ensemble that generalizes ETH, matches gravitational disk correlators, and determines cylinder amplitudes and their UV pathologies?

Can one fixed holographic CFT state have two simple semiclassical bulk descriptions differing by the presence of a closed universe? Which bulk-boundary dictionary and inner product then describe an observer's experience?

How can the maximally extended Schwarzschild-AdS spacetime, including its interior, be described nonperturbatively, and how can its exponentially decaying semiclassical correlators be reconciled with boundary unitarity?
How do positive-Λ perfect-fluid cosmologies differ in causal structure, and what do their horizons imply for a proposed dS/CFT renormalization group interpretation and covariant entropy bounds?
How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT encode multiple natural vacua in time-dependent backgrounds, and how does cosmological particle production relate bulk and boundary in-in versus in-out correlators?
How do horizons, thermodynamics and de Sitter vacuum ambiguities in the AdS bubble of nothing and locally AdS black hole map to their boundary CFT?
Can AdS/CFT realize interacting theories with multiple gravitons, which gravitons remain massless, and what bulk structures describe large-N CFTs coupled through products of operators?
How can boundary conformal-field-theory observables be computed from bulk supergravity or string theory, including operator dimensions, protected spectra and large-N thermodynamics?

To what extent can local bulk string and supergravity dynamics be recovered from CFT operators, particularly beyond the free large-N limit, and what can this description say about black-hole infall, complementarity, and the BTZ singularity?

How can boundary SYM encode distant bulk collisions before their signals reach the boundary, while its stress tensor subsequently exhibits apparently instantaneous redistribution, superluminal oscillations and negative local energy?
